## 3. Scaled "AAA" definition for a KFB stylized 2–4 minute game
"AAA" here means source-faithful, coherent clay/Playmation craft and polished controls, visuals and audio—**not** photorealism, maximum systems, lots of content, or guaranteed commercial AAA studio production. Reuse actual owner 3D visual gate (mean >=8/no item <6/K9>=7/K10>=7) and a **specific POC playability gate**; DO NOT inherit WB2 global 8.5 rubric without explicit WS0 reauthorization.

### Evidence gates, not extra approval rounds
| Gate | Evidence that WSA's one productive run must collect | Hard blocker vs tune |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Q0 SOURCE & CANON | exactly pinned current `game/proc-world-ws0` FB_CANON A11, Jetpack + tanks, existing Gatling, combat/VFX/Fluff/OSM/KayKit source intact; `test/fb-canon.mjs` source/Build PASS; source image/animation fit and rights/GLB identity | Wrong source/actor, broken asset, secret exposure = BLOCK |
| Q1 TECHNICAL HOST | React Three Fiber/Rapier Host Contract R1.2, one player/camera/physics/Audio owner, modules create/update/dispose, no second canvas, successful build and no unexplained browser errors; deterministic event/graph tests | broken boot or duplicate authority = BLOCK |
| Q2 PLAYABLE GOLDEN LOOP | keyboard+tap enters, controls FB flight/Gatling, sees Goo/Fluff route, changes one validated node, causes genuine source-owned hit/suck/build or repair, completes a 2–4 min goal, restart with fixed seed; source/physics truth same as graphics | missing full loop, cannot finish, false route = BLOCK |
| Q3 CANON 3D | actual source KayKit/FB objects, KFB palette/clay/one light, terrain3 masked where source-backed, true road/bridge overpass logic, real rooted collider/contact; critic K1–K10 fixed views with silhouette/greyscale/thumbnail, play-speed video | failing binding CANON = BLOCK unless WS0 explicitly approves exception |
| Q4 CARTOON FEEL & SOUND | one genuine switch elastic snap, one legal Fluff reaction, one source-owned soft feedback cue, one clear destructive and reconstructive cascade, no duplicate cues; audio muted/reduced-motion still readable | core action unreadable = BLOCK; excess polish = TUNE |
| Q5 DEVICE & PERFORMANCE | real target desktop + mobile browser input, camera legibility/touch affordance, objective clarity, save/return, FX ON/OFF frame-time p50/p95 & draw calls; actual baseline before setting thresholds; no fake 60fps | unusable target device = BLOCK; unapproved FPS number never claimed |
| Q6 SECURITY & PRIVATE SITE | authenticated/protected path and assets, authorized Stefan/Georg access, no client tokens, test direct asset URL and refresh deep routes, no unintended public exposure, private Repo/GLB source safely bundled | public leak/broken access = BLOCK |
| Q7 EXTERNAL BLIND REVIEW | isolated fresh critic identity/session and prompt, receives only candidate URL+commit+reference+rubric, uses real inputs, captures OWN continuous 2–4 min play + source-specific still frames/console/perf; own K1–K10 verdict plus game feel issues, not Builder self-report | if cannot run → CRITIC_NOT_RUN; not declared QA-complete |
| Q8 GUARD & HUMAN | independent Production Guard routes CONTINUE/REPAIR/QUARANTINE/HUMAN_DECISION/STOP, only blocker repair on critical seam; Georg final PASS/TUNE/FAIL. Publish to Stefan only after actual authorized guard and security gate | Builder cannot self-promote |

**AAA gates do not mean nine new Site jobs.** Q0–Q6 are evidence collected inside the ONE existing Work run and its test harness; Q7 is one fresh external agent run; Q8 is a short read-only route/human decision. All technical subchecks can be repeated locally by Builder/Tester without additional Georg approvals.

## 4. Precise blind critic prompt/data firewall
- Different agent/process/session from Builder, with isolated context. Name model/session, timestamp, candidate build SHA, exact URL, authorized access, fixed seed and device in test report.
- Prompt should give ONLY accepted current KFB CANON_3D references, source manifest for FB_CANON/KayKit and V-962 POC behavior/entry, and fixed visual/play rubric; NOT the builder's work log, PR description explaining issues, self-grade, repair plan or screenshots as sole ground truth.
- Critic opens actual secured Site (authorized viewer identity), drives 2–4 min game without hidden debug routes, tests gamepad/touch if available, takes its own screenshot/movie and runtime/console observation. If device access blocked, report exact partial evidence and CRITIC_NOT_RUN for complete external pass.
- Blind 3D pass on K1–K10 by actual captured scene evidence; separately score 5 POC user-facing concerns from observable evidence (goal comprehension, controllability, tactile response, material/city legibility, AV comfort). For this POC use qualitative PASS/TUNE/FAIL anchored in failed action evidence; numeric thresholds only if WS0 adopts clear rubric. No made-up "AAA 9.5" score.
- Return only ranked observable blockers and one repair order; no production code. Guard assesses impact; Builder only repairs genuine first-blocking seam. At most two Work/WSA rounds per R2 step; no user-facing micro-slice.
- Georg's own judgment supersedes all automated grades.

Phase 1 Sources+Design: same currently approved V-962 steps, user accepts source image and moodboard once.
Phase 2 Builder one integrated product: core → one true small OSM/Raster/WFC source-safe field → FB/flight/Gatling/Goo/Fluff/point-tap and grappling subject to verified host owner → feedback → protected Site. Phase 3 Fixed-score blind acceptance: one build frozen commit → Q0–Q6 actual evidence → ONE independent external blind critic Q7 → one Guard Q8; critical repair if any and optional ONE independent re-review before handoff. Optional Sweet/4GTN/Qiva/card campaign/extra sound generation deferred unless required under V-962.
Use V-962 "up to two rounds per step" for production budget, NOT to suppress mandatory independent final review. Don't copy WB2's whole-game 9-dimensional gauntlet or fixed 8.5 threshold.
